notes: detectFabricLoaderVersion (line 450-456) sorts the loader-version directory names as plain strings and takes .last — not a semantic-version comparison. "0.15.9" sorts before "0.9.0" lexicographically ('1' < '9' at the second character), so .last picks "0.9.0" even though 0.15.9 is the newer loader release. This is a genuine MSC 1 quirk, preserved as-is per CLAUDE.md's port-not-rewrite rule — not a bug this port should silently correct.
